mission_03: Well done! You have successfully implemented basic image data augmentations using NumPy. You learned how to perform horizontal flips with np.fliplr(), rotations with np.rot90(), and brightness adjustments with scalar multiplication and clipping. These augmentations quadrupled your dataset size from 5 to 20 images. In practice, image augmentation libraries like albumentations, torchvision.transforms, and imgaug provide comprehensive, optimized augmentation pipelines with many more transformations. The key principle is to apply augmentations that reflect realistic variations your model will encounter in production.
